question.html:
A mass-spring system oscillates with simple harmonic motion (SHM). What is true about the restoring force that acts on the system?

  1. It is proportional to the amplitude of the oscillations.
  2. It is pointing in the opposite direction to the displacement for half of the period. 
  3. It is proportional to the displacement from the equilibrium position.
  4. It is pointing away from the equilibrium position.
